name: product-advice-agent
description: Product-advice agent (Python + Langfuse) with the SDLC kit. The kit scripts need Node >= 22 and nothing else; the product needs uv (npm run setup:worktree).

scripts.verify: npm run test:kit && npm run verify:product
scripts.verify:product: uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
